observedIndicators: Failure occurred inside generated cache replay file (.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js) during DETERMINISTIC mode.
Cached selector sought '[data-testid=input-lastname]' / 'Last Name *', but failure screenshot shows the form fields have changed to 'Your Name *', 'Contact Email *', and 'Occupation *'.
Application rendered without browser console errors or network failures (0 errors).
The overall page.ai instruction is semantically flexible ('Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...'), which can adapt autonomously on fresh execution.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and re-run automation
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache for 'tests/unstable-survey.test.ts' and re-run the test to allow autonomous regeneration of form filling steps against the updated DOM.

plan.notes: The failure occurred during deterministic cache replay inside .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js. The cached script attempted to locate 'Last Name *' / '[data-testid=input-lastname]', but the current page layout presents 'Your Name *' and 'Contact Email *'. Since the original test instruction ('Fill out all of the survey questions with fake data...') is semantically flexible and the page renders cleanly without application errors, clearing the cache and retrying autonomously will resolve the failure.
